response.sql: WITH price_stats AS ( SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) as mean_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number ), item_counts AS ( SELECT invoice_number, COUNT(*) as total_line_items FROM Invoice_Line_Items GROUP BY invoice_number ) SELECT AVG(ps.mean_price) as avg_of_mean_prices, AVG(ic.total_line_items) as avg_line_items_per_invoice FROM price_stats ps JOIN item_counts ic ON ps.invoice_number = ic.invoice_number

assumptions.assumption: Both metrics are calculated over the same set of invoices: those with at least one line item having a non-NULL product_price. Invoices with only NULL prices or no line items are excluded from both averages.

alternatives.interpretation: The two metrics are calculated over different sets of invoices. The first metric (average of mean prices) is for invoices with at least one non-NULL price. The second metric (average line item count) is for all invoices in the database, including those with zero line items.
alternatives.sql: WITH price_stats AS ( SELECT invoice_number, AVG(product_price) as mean_price FROM Invoice_Line_Items WHERE product_price IS NOT NULL GROUP BY invoice_number ), all_item_counts AS ( SELECT i.invoice_number, COUNT(ili.order_item_id) as total_line_items FROM Invoices i LEFT JOIN Invoice_Line_Items ili ON i.invoice_number = ili.invoice_number GROUP BY i.invoice_number ) SELECT (SELECT AVG(mean_price) FROM price_stats) as avg_of_mean_prices, (SELECT AVG(total_line_items) FROM all_item_counts) as avg_line_items_per_invoice
